newsitem.title: FRANCE: Juppe to confirm French 98 spend cap to ministers.
newsitem.headline: Juppe to confirm French 98 spend cap to ministers.

text.p: French Prime Minister Alain Juppe is due to send letters to ministries on Wednesday confirming 1998 spending will be frozen for the second year running at 1,563 billion francs ($270 billion), government sources said on Wednesday.
As in the 1997 budget, this implies a cut in real terms once inflation is taken into account.
Juppe said on Tuesday, in a campaign speech for the May/June parliamentary election, that tax cuts would continue and go further as a result of spending cuts. ($ = 5.781 French Francs)
